This is Obscura, an open-source headless browser for AI agents and web scraping, written in Rust.
It runs real JavaScript through V8, and it speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
So Puppeteer and Playwright connect to it as a drop-in replacement for headless Chrome.
A static HTML page loads in 51 ms. Chrome takes around 500 ms.
Pages with JavaScript, XHR and fetch load in 84 ms, against roughly 800 in Chrome.
Stealth mode randomizes the fingerprint for every session and blocks 3,520 tracker domains.
It even inspired the first prototype of Cloudflare Kitesurf, which began by porting Obscura to Workers.
For AI agents, it ships an MCP server with tools to navigate, click, read snapshots and take screenshots.
To start, grab a single binary from Releases. There is no Chrome, no Node.js, and no dependencies.
Then run obscura fetch with any URL, or start the CDP server on port 9222.

Obscura. A whole headless browser in 30 MB.
